title: Map pin pulse
description: Use to mark places on a world map: pins drop in and send out pulsing rings with city labels (offline).
props: {pins?: {name: string; lon: number; lat: number}[] /*London, New York, Tokyo*/; landColor?: string; strokeColor?: string; pinColor?: string /*'#f43f5e'*/; textColor?: string; staggerFrames?: number /*10*/; fontFamily?: string}
